titulo: Multidimensional Portals in GTA 6: Part 1 — Portal to old Vice City (cartoon, EN)
fuente: Player discovery (unconfirmed); version in English for @gta6encyclopedia.en

escenas.voz: Did Jason just break time in GTA VI?
Players found a portal inside the nuclear plant.
Jason travels to an old Vice City, and Kent Paul is there.
The portal brings them both back. Kent is key in Vice City and San Andreas.
When they return, Throwback one of five appears: looks like four more trips.
